result.title: DetailScale-SR: Decoupling Restoration and Continuous Detail Control for Real-World Super-Resolution
result.summary: Real-world image super-resolution often seeks the most detailed plausible reconstruction, although more detail is not always desirable. The same degraded image may require restrained restoration, faithful reconstruction, or enhanced visual detail according to user intent. We present DetailScale-SR, a preference-conditioned framework that continuously controls reconstructed detail for a fixed low-resolution input without altering the scene being restored. Rather than relying on post-processing or repeatedly rewriting prompts, it learns a continuous family of reconstructions while separating content recovery from detail preference. This enables a smooth transition from conservative restoration to richly textured results under consistent input and semantic constraints. Its controllable range also extends beyond conventional restoration: DetailScale-SR can enhance high-frequency structures and generate perceptually richer textures than the paired high-resolution reference. Text restoration is another distinct strength. For text-rich scenes, especially Chinese posters and signs, it recovers more legible and character-faithful text than prior generative SR methods under matched textual guidance. DetailScale-SR therefore unifies continuous detail control, beyond-reference enhancement, and reliable recovery of semantically important content. Our model is available at https://modelscope.cn/models/DiffSynth-Studio/Qwen-Image-2.1-SR

AI.brief_summary: 提出偏好条件化的超分框架 DetailScale-SR，在固定低分辨率输入下把内容恢复与细节偏好解耦，用一个连续控制量实现从保守复原到超出参考的高频纹理增强的平滑过渡，并改善文字区域的可读性恢复。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作属图像复原与生成，与 VLM 推理无直接关系；但其「内容恢复与细节强度可分离、以连续量调节细节注入程度」的思路，可能为 LVR 中视觉细节保留程度与任务必要信息保真度的可控解耦提供类比，可供核查。
